$comment: The languages of the UI (internal/platform-spec.md 11.8), in the order of the language picker. `code` is what the setting ui_locale and the file names locales/<code>.json hold, `tag` the BCP 47 tag of Intl and <html lang>, `native` the name in the language itself. English and Russian live in the dictionaries (i18n.ts); every other one in locales/<code>.json beside them (scripts/i18n.mjs).
